details: Bitcoin is trading around $60,000, facing selling pressure and a lack of buyer conviction, with retail sentiment indicating "Extreme Fear" (Fear and Greed Index around 17). Amidst this, MicroStrategy (MSTR) has introduced a new Digital Credit Framework, allowing for the sale of up to $1.25 billion in BTC. This strategic shift aims to enhance liquidity, fund dividends, and facilitate stock buybacks, departing from its previous pure accumulation approach to strengthen the company's financial position.
title: Bitcoin Struggles at $60K; MicroStrategy Pivots BTC Strategy

details: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has published its comprehensive crypto regulatory framework, outlining prudential requirements, market abuse controls, and stablecoin standards. Firms including exchanges, custodians, stablecoin issuers, and staking providers will need to obtain authorization by October 25, 2027. A notable revision includes reducing the capital coefficient for stablecoin issuance from a proposed 2% to 1% following industry feedback, aiming to balance innovation with necessary safeguards.
title: UK Finalizes Crypto Framework, Eases Stablecoin Capital Rules

details: BNY Mellon has expanded its digital asset custody services, enabling institutional clients to directly mint, redeem, hold, and transfer Circle's USDC stablecoin. This development deepens BNY's collaboration with Circle, moving beyond merely holding reserves to offering direct stablecoin services. The integration provides a regulated, bank-based pathway for large institutions to access stablecoin issuance and redemption.
title: BNY Mellon Unlocks USDC Minting & Redemption for Institutions

details: Self-exiled Chinese billionaire Guo Wengui, also known as Miles Guo, has been sentenced to 30 years in a U.S. prison for orchestrating a crypto-related fraud scheme. He was ordered to forfeit $889 million in restitution, stemming from a conspiracy that defrauded thousands of individuals of over $1 billion through a supposed crypto asset named "H-Coin" or "Himalaya Coin."
title: Chinese Billionaire Guo Wengui Gets 30 Years for Crypto Fraud

details: XRP's price is currently holding near $1.05, as buyers actively defend the critical $1 support level despite a recent downtrend. The network has seen a significant surge in activity, including the creation of nearly 5,000 new wallets in a single day and bullish social sentiment reaching a three-month peak. However, the price remains under pressure, with a 6% decline over the past week, and a confirmed sustained recovery is still pending as positive network signals contend with weak price momentum.
title: XRP Defends $1 Support as Wallet Growth Surges
